summary: Let the Create backup repository form browse NFS exports and SMB3 shares and folders with the same Core discovery as VM storage, flagging folders that already hold a backup repository.

guide.reason: The backup repository steps describe Browse exports and Browse shared folders, the E marker and browsing troubleshooting.

api.reason: POST /api/v1/storage/discover (StorageDiscoveryRequest) gains the optional purpose field, valid for nfs and smb only and gated by the storage-discovery-purpose-v1 Core capability (409 when absent; older Cores would silently ignore it). With purpose backup an SMB candidate's existing flag reports a backup repository's owner.json instead of VM storage's marker. No new route, Core command or durable state.

roadmap.reason: Operator convenience on an existing backup repository workflow; no milestone or acceptance status changes.

state.reason: Discovery is a transient pool-master observation; Controller and Core journal, cache and store nothing from it. Registration still records the repository on the pool master as before.

verification.method: On 2026-10-03: go test ./internal/protocol ./internal/controller and go test ./internal/vmhost -run Discover passed, including the new test that a backup-purpose SMB discovery flags only owner.json and the new purpose validation test. npm run typecheck and the web tests passed at that time, before the later review-fix round, which did not rerun them; the backup form test drives the real component to check the NFS and SMB3 discovery requests, the credential-gated button and the stale-master refusal. generate_api.py --check passed. Not executed: a browser walkthrough of the picker on the backup form and a run against a real NFS/SMB server.
